correctness.rationale: For every integer q>=3 with exactly 2q distinct q-ary codewords of length 2q-1, each coordinate separates at most e3(a_1,...,a_q)<=8*C(q,3) triples; Maclaurin/AM-GM is sharp only at symbol occupancies 2 each. Averaging gives min trifference <=2q-4. At equality every triple is nonseparated in exactly three coordinates, so for induced matching edge counts m_uv, m_uv+m_uw+m_vw=3 and sum_w m_uw=2q-1. Summing over w yields (2q-4)(m_uv-1)=0, whence every pair occurs once: all coordinate matchings form a one-factorization. Odd-modulus cyclic round-robin construction is a converse for all q. For q=3 explicit K6 enumeration gives 15 matchings, 6 factorizations in one relabeling orbit and 6*5!*(3!)^5/6!=7776 fixed-position unlabeled-message codebooks. The classification is not a claim about maximum code size for arbitrary q or single-separation codes.
residual_risks: The q=3 counts are finite exhaustive checks, whereas the all-q statement follows from averaging and edge-count equations. Larger one-factorization isomorphism classes are not enumerated.
